tldr: Saturn in Pisces: discipline must be learned through compassion, faith, and boundaries with the unseen.
body: With Saturn in Pisces, the work is giving shape to intuition and learning that spiritual life still needs structure. Sensitivity becomes trustworthy when it has boundaries.
gift: Spiritual discipline, compassionate responsibility, and the ability to ground imagination.
challenge: Escapism, porous limits, and confusing avoidance with surrender.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
